descriere_scurta: VSM line filter overtemperature alarm threshold
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for the KTY temperature sensor of the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM) to monitor the line filter temperature. Prerequisite: A KTY84 sensor is connected and p3665 is set to 2.

descriere_scurta: VSM line filter overtemperature shutdown threshold
descriere: Sets the shutdown threshold for the KTY temperature sensor of the VSM to monitor the line filter temperature.

descriere_scurta: VSM line filter overtemperature hysteresis
descriere: Sets the hysteresis for the alarm threshold of the VSM to monitor the line filter temperature.

descriere_scurta: VSM 10 V input CT gain
descriere: Sets CT gain of the CT connected at the 10 V input of the Voltage Sensing Module (VSM). The parameter specifies the current magnitude in [A] referred to the input voltage at the VSM in [V].

descriere_scurta: VSM line filter capacitance alarm threshold
descriere: Sets the alarm threshold for the change of the capacitance of the line filter. The monitoring of the filter capacitance is de-activated with p3676 = 0.00 %.

descriere_scurta: Braking Module internal inhibit
descriere: Sets the signal source to inhibit the internal Braking Module. BI: p3680 = 1 signal: The Braking Module is inhibited. BI: p3680 = 0 signal: The Braking Module is enabled.

descriere_scurta: Activating Braking Module internal DC link fast discharge
descriere: Sets the signal source to activate the DC link fast discharge for an internal braking module. When the following conditions apply, the DC link fast discharge is started later with delay time (p3682): - BI: p3681 = 1 signal. - an external line contactor is opened via r0863.1 "energize contactor". The DC link fast discharge is interrupted when the following conditions apply: - BI: p3681 = 0 signal. - ON command for the infeed.

descriere_scurta: Braking Module internal DC link fast discharge delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for switching in the DC link fast discharge for an internal Braking Module.

descriere_scurta: Braking Module internal activation threshold brake chopper
descriere: Sets the activation threshold for the braking chopper.

descriere_scurta: APC configuration
descriere: Sets the configuration for APC (Advanced Positioning Control).

descriere_scurta: APC enc sel
descriere: Sets the number of the encoder used for for APC (Advanced Positioning Control).

descriere_scurta: Friction characteristic activation
descriere: Setting to activate and de-activate the friction characteristic.

descriere_scurta: Friction characteristic record activation
descriere: Setting for the friction characteristic record. After the next power-on command, the friction characteristic is automatically recorded.

descriere_scurta: Number of Braking Modules connected in parallel
descriere: Sets the number of Braking Modules connected in parallel in a DC link.

descriere_scurta: Braking Module DC link fast discharge delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for switching in the DC link fast discharge.

descriere_scurta: Activating Braking Module DC link fast discharge
descriere: Sets the signal source to activate the DC link fast discharge. The DC link fast discharge is started later with delay time (p3862) when the following conditions apply: - BI: p3863 = 1 signal. - an external line contactor is opened via r0863.1 "energize contactor". The DC link fast discharge is interrupted when the following conditions apply: - BI: p3863 = 0 signal. - ON command for the infeed.

descriere_scurta: Long stator configuration
descriere: Sets the configuration when operating a long stator motor.

descriere_scurta: Set long stator signal source commutation angle (p3872)
descriere: Sets the signal source to set the commutation angle available via connector input p3872.

descriere_scurta: Long stator signal source commutation angle
descriere: Sets the signal source for the commutation angle. This angle is set for a 0/1 signal edge via BI: p3871.

descriere_scurta: Long stator sig. source changeover to cl.-loop ctrl w/ enc.
descriere: Sets the signal source to change over to closed-loop control with encoder.

descriere_scurta: Long stator signal source commutation angle oper. with encoder /
descriere: Sets the signal source for the commutation angle for operation with encoder.

descriere_scurta: Unpark long stator signal source 1 encoder
descriere: Sets the signal source 1 to unpark the encoder.

descriere_scurta: Long stator commutation angle 1
descriere: Sets the commutation angle 1 for long stator motors.

descriere_scurta: Long stator commutation angle 2
descriere: Sets the commutation angle 2 for long stator motors.

descriere_scurta: Completion of quick commissioning
descriere: Exits the quick commissioning (p0010 = 1) with automatic calculation of all of the parameters that depend on the entries made during the quick commissioning.

descriere_scurta: Service parameter
descriere: For service personnel only.

descriere_scurta: Fan operating hours counter
descriere: Displays the measured operating hours since the last fan replacement.

descriere_scurta: Faults acknowledge drive object
descriere: Setting to acknowledge all active faults of a drive object.

descriere_scurta: Master control mode selection
descriere: Sets the mode to change over the master control / LOCAL mode.

descriere_scurta: Set input or output
descriere: Sets the bidirectional digital inputs/outputs as an input or output.

descriere_scurta: TB30 signal source for terminal DO 0

descriere_scurta: TB30 signal source for terminal DO 1

descriere_scurta: TB30 signal source for terminal DO 3
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DO 3 (X481.8) of the Terminal Board 30 (TB30).

descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 4 (X520.6) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 5

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 7
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 7 (X520.9) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: Signal source for terminal DI/DO 1 decentral
descriere: Sets the signal source for the decentral terminal DI/DO 1 (X3.4).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 10
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 10 (X521.4) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 11
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 11 (X521.5) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 12 (X521.6) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 13
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 13 (X521.7) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 14
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 14 (X521.8) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 15
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 15 (X521.9) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM31 digital outputs limit current
descriere: Sets the limit for the total output voltage of terminals X541.1, X541.2, X541.3 and X541.4 (DI/DO 8 ... 11) of Terminal Module 31 (TM31).

descriere_scurta: Invert digital outputs
descriere: Setting to invert the signals at the digital outputs.

descriere_scurta: TM15 digital inputs/outputs set the mode
descriere: Sets the mode of the DI/DOs of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 16
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 16 (X522.2) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 17
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 17 (X522.3) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 18
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 18 (X522.4) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 19
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 19 (X522.5) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 20 (X522.6) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 21
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 21 (X522.7) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 22
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 22 (X522.8) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: TM15DI/DO signal source for terminal DI/DO 23
descriere: Sets the signal source for terminal DI/DO 23 (X522.9) of Terminal Module 15 (TM15).

descriere_scurta: S120M digital inputs simulation mode
descriere: Sets the simulation mode for digital inputs of the S120M.

descriere_scurta: S120M digital inputs simulation mode setpoint
descriere: Sets the setpoint for the input signals in the digital input simulation mode of the S120M.

descriere_scurta: Inputs/outputs sampling time
descriere: Sets the sampling time for the inputs and outputs. Index: [0] = S120M input/output sampling time

descriere_scurta: Spindle supplementary temperature sensor type
descriere: Sets the sensor type to evaluate the spindle supplementary temperature.

descriere_scurta: Spindle supplementary temperature delay time
descriere: Sets the delay time for the output of the fault for the temperature evaluation of the spindle. The timer is started when the alarm threshold (p4102[0]) is exceeded. If the delay time has expired and the alarm threshold has, in the meantime, not been fallen below, then fault F07018 is output. The fault can be acknowledged, if, after the delay time has expired, the alarm threshold is again fallen below. If the fault threshold (p4102[1]) is exceeded before the delay time has expired, then fault F07018 is immediately output.

descriere_scurta: TM150 filter rated line frequency
descriere: Sets the rated line frequency for the filter to skip the line frequency for Terminal Module 150 (TM150).

descriere_scurta: TM17 enable DI/DO 0 ... 5
descriere: Sets the enable signal with bits 0 ... 5 for DI/DO 0 ... 5 of Terminal Module 17 (TM17). Sets the triggering of the enable signal with bits 8 ... 13. The following assignment applies: Enable signal for DI/DO 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 via DI/DO 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 or 15.

descriere_scurta: TM17 smoothing time constant digital input 0 ... 15
descriere: Sets the smoothing time constant for digital input 0 ... 15 of Terminal Module 17 (TM17).

descriere_scurta: TM17 time absolute/relative digital output 0 ... 15
descriere: Sets as absolute or relative timing with bit 0 ... 15 for digital output 0 ... 15 of Terminal Module 17 (TM17).

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation operating mode
descriere: Sets the operating mode for the incremental encoder emulation.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation mode
descriere: Sets the mode for the incremental encoder emulation.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation controller options
descriere: Sets the controller option for incremental encoder emulation on Terminal Module 41 (TM41).

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation pulse number leading encoder
descriere: Parameters p4408 and p4418 define the position setpoint format for the TM41 (CI: p4420). The two parameters p4408 and p4418 of the TM41 must be set the same as parameters p0408 and p0418 of the encoder interconnected at connector input p4420. The zero mark is only correctly output if this condition is maintained. For p4408 = 0, the following applies: Parameters p0408 and p0418 in addition assume the function of p4408 and p4418.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation fine resolution leading encoder
descriere: Parameters p4408 and p4418 define the position setpoint format for the TM41 (CI: p4420). The two parameters p4408 and p4418 of the TM41 must be set the same as parameters p0408 and p0418 of the encoder interconnected at connector input p4420. The zero mark is only correctly output if this condition is maintained. For p4408 = 0, the following applies: Parameters p0408 and p0418 in addition assume the function of p4408 and p4418.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation position setpoint
descriere: Sets the signal source for the incremental encoder emulation position setpoint.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation deadtime compensation
descriere: Sets the deadtime compensation for incremental encoder emulation. This factor defines the multiplier in which the encoder position setpoint of the incremental encoder emulation is shifted depending on the velocity.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation position setpoint inversion
descriere: Setting to invert the position setpoint for Terminal Module 41 (TM41). 0 -> Position setpoint (CI: p4420) is evaluated as normal. 1 -> Position setpoint (CI: p4420) is processed inverted.

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation standstill adaptation
descriere: Sets standstill adaptation on Terminal Module 41 (TM41).

descriere_scurta: TM41 encoder emulation pulses for zero mark
descriere: Sets pulse number to output the zero mark for the incremental encoder simulation/emulation.

descriere_scurta: Encoder functional reserve component number
descriere: Sets the component number (p0141) of the encoder whose functional reserve is to be displayed (r4651).

descriere_scurta: XIST1_ERW reset mode
descriere: Sets the mode to reset the actual value in XIST_ERW (CO: r4653).

descriere_scurta: XIST1_ERW reset signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source to reset XIST1_ERW (CO: r4653).

descriere_scurta: Sensor Module filter bandwidth
descriere: Sets the filter bandwidth for Sensor Module SMx10 (resolver) and SMx20 (sin/cos). The value set on the Sensor Module is displayed in r4661. The Sensor Module hardware only supports the following values: - 0: The Sensor Module's default is used. - 50 kHz - 170 kHz - 500 kHz - Unlimited: Only the bandwidth of the operational amplifier is effective.

descriere_scurta: Zero mark monitoring differential pulse count
descriere: Displays the number of differential pulses for the zero mark monitoring that have accumulated. If fault F3x131 is re-parameterized to alarm (A) or no message (N), the encoder pulses which have not been corrected are added to the accumulator (p4688).

descriere_scurta: SMI spare part component number
descriere: Sets the component number for the SMI/DQI for which motor and/or encoder data should be saved, deleted or downloaded.

descriere_scurta: SMI spare part save/download data
descriere: Setting for the saving/downloading/deletion of motor and/or encoder data for the component specified in p4690 (SMI/DQI). A backup of this data can be saved to non-volatile memory. The backup procedure is performed automatically as part of the function for saving to non-volatile memory (p0977 = 1 or "Copy RAM to ROM"). If a part is replaced, the saved data can be reloaded. Procedure:

descriere_scurta: SMI spare part save data of all SMIs
descriere: Setting to back up the data of all SMIs and DQIs featured in the target topology.

descriere_scurta: Measuring function control
descriere: Setting to control the measurement function.

descriere_scurta: Measurement function configuration
descriere: Setting to configure the measurement function.

descriere_scurta: Measuring function number of averaging operations
descriere: Sets the number of averaging operations for the measuring function.

descriere_scurta: Measuring function number of stabilizing periods
descriere: Sets the number of stabilizing periods for the measuring function.

descriere_scurta: Trace memory bank changeover
descriere: Changes over the memory bank to read out the contents of the trace buffer.

descriere_scurta: Function generator control
descriere: The function generator is started with p4800 = 1. The signal is only generated for a 1 signal of binector input p4819.

descriere_scurta: Function generator mode
descriere: Sets the operating mode of the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator physical address
descriere: Sets the physical address where the function generator is to be connected.

descriere_scurta: Function generator physical address reference value
descriere: Sets the reference value for 100 % for referred inputs.

descriere_scurta: Function generator output signal integer number scaling
descriere: Sets the scaling for the integer number of the output signal for the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator control
descriere: Sets the signal source to control the function generator. When the function generator is running, signal generation is stopped with a 0 signal from BI: p4819 and p4800 is set to 0.

descriere_scurta: Function generator signal shape
descriere: Sets the signal to be generated for the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator period
descriere: Sets the period of the signal to be generated for the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator pulse width
descriere: Sets the pulse width for the signal to be generated for the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator bandwidth
descriere: Sets the bandwidth for the signal to be generated for the function generator.

descriere_scurta: Function generator amplitude
descriere: Sets the amplitude for the signal to be generated for the function generator.
